notes.title: Update 0.5.3.882
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes
Added Zombie Player vision and player tracking
AI will now wander and are attracted to loud noises
AI spawn more gradually
Fixed AI floating in the air
Fixed infected getting stuck under L shaped building
Fixed building collider to prevent walking through wall
Shipping crate vaulting is easier
Fixed Play Area ending in water
Fixed Play Area restricting while in Pre-Game

Menu Changes
Add news feed to main menu
Improved visibility of Ready button
Added Guide/Leaderboards links
Fixed modal dialog cancel with Esc

(HOT FIX) 0.5.4.883
Fixed extreme lag when pressing certain controller buttons

notes.title: Update 0.5.2.850
notes.content:
Changes

When a match ends it will automatically start another match with the same people
While waiting in a room every player can "Ready Up" to skip the "Match Starts In" timer.
You can now join a game in any state, even if it just ended.
You can press Play instead of Join/Create and it will automatically find the best game.
Fixed time of day and weather
The play area is faster to improve the pace of the game.
Every time the play area is restricting an audio/visual queue notifies the player.
Regional servers have been reduced to increase the available player count globally.
